File	Description
index.html	Adds the complete Firebase speaking-coach web app UI + client logic.
src/index.ts	Implements pluginFirebaseSpeakingCoach for config validation/injection; keeps pluginExample alias.
firestore.rules	Introduces rules for progress, history, and scenarios with admin-claim writes.
scripts/import-scenarios.js	Adds a Node-based CSV → Firestore bulk importer using batched writes.
scripts/scenarios.csv	Provides starter scenario prompts across CEFR levels.
README.md	Rewrites docs to match the Firebase speaking-coach template and usage.
package.json	Fixes simple-git-hooks pre-commit command serialization.
.gitignore	Ignores Firebase service-account key files.
playground/src/index.js	Updates playground page content to reference the new template.
